advisor.greeting: Namaste! I'm the Accel Business advisor. Tell me a little about your business - what you do, which city you're in and how many people work with you - and I'll put together a plan with one clear monthly price.

ask.business_type: What kind of business do you run?
ask.city: Which city is your business in?
ask.employees: How many people work in the business, including you?
ask.sites: How many shops, branches or offices do you have?
ask.gstin: Do you have a GST registration (GSTIN)? If yes, you can type it and I'll verify it now.
ask.needs: What matters most to you? Pick any that apply, or tap 'Show my plan'.
ask.spend: Roughly how much do you spend on internet and phones each month today? This helps me keep the plan within budget.

advisor.not_serviceable: Thanks! Online sign-up isn't available in {city} yet. I've asked a local Accel partner to call you - they can check what we can offer at your address.
advisor.recommend_intro: Here's what I'd recommend for {business} in {city}:
advisor.recommend_summary: One price: ₹{monthly}/month + GST, one-time setup ₹{setup}, {contract}-month term, ready in about {days} days. You can switch add-ons on or off on the next screen.
advisor.escalate: No problem - I've requested a call-back from an Accel Business expert in {language}. You'll get a call within one working day; your answers so far are saved, so you won't have to repeat them.
advisor.gstin_verified: GSTIN verified against the registry (mock): {name}, status {status}.
advisor.gstin_inactive: That GSTIN shows as {status} in the registry, so products that need an active GST registration can't be added. I'll recommend plans that work without it.
advisor.gstin_not_found: I couldn't find that GSTIN in the registry. Please check the number - you can continue without it for now.
advisor.gstin_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid GSTIN (15 characters, e.g. 27ABCDE1234F1Z5). Please check it, or tap 'No GSTIN'.
advisor.only_mobile: Sure - you can buy just business mobile lines. How many lines do you need?
advisor.fallback: Sorry, I didn't catch that. You can also tap one of the options below.
advisor.faq_prefix: {name}: {description}. Price ₹{price}/{unit} per month, minimum term {contract} months.
advisor.llm_offline_note: Advisor running in offline mode (rule-based understanding).

reasons.TYPICAL: {name} - chosen by {pct}% of similar businesses that signed up

violations.TIER_NOT_SERVED: {name} isn't available in your city yet.
violations.MIN_EMPLOYEES: {name} is for businesses with at least {min} people.
violations.GSTIN_NOT_ACTIVE: {name} needs an active GST registration (yours shows as {status}).
violations.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: {name} works only with a fibre or leased-line connection in the same plan.
violations.QTY_EXCEEDS_SITES: {name}: you have {sites} site(s), so the quantity can't be {qty}.
violations.QTY_EXCEEDS_CONNECTED_SITES: {name} can only be added at sites that have a qualifying connection ({connected_sites}).
violations.INVALID_QUANTITY: Please choose a quantity of at least 1.
violations.UNKNOWN_PRODUCT: That product isn't in the catalogue.

notes.FIBRE_FALLBACK: Fibre isn't available at your address, so we've used 5G AirFiber, which needs no cable work.
notes.GST_BLOCKED: Some products (like WhatsApp Business API, SMS and leased lines) need an active GSTIN, so they're not included.
notes.SPEND_COMPARISON: You spend about ₹{current}/month today. This plan is ₹{recommended}/month; the Starter option is ₹{starter}/month.
notes.BUDGET_OVER: This plan is above your budget of ₹{budget}. The Starter option is ₹{starter}/month.
notes.NOT_SERVICEABLE: Online sign-up isn't available in {city} yet.
